Reports from Lebanon indicate that at least six lives were tragically lost in a brutal Syrian war plane attack on the town of Yabroud, situated just across the border from Lebanon. The attack also left nine individuals wounded near the Lebanese town of Arsal, a community that provides sanctuary for countless refugees fleeing the violence in Syria. Some of the injured were rushed to Arsal, while others were transported to Baalbek, the bustling metropolis nestled in Lebanon's Bekaa Valley. The conflict in Syria has spilled over into Lebanon, with both sides finding support and supply routes within its borders. Meanwhile, across the border in Turkey, a stray bullet fired from Syria claimed the life of a man in the border town of Ceylanpinar, marking the fourth casualty on the Turkish side amidst ongoing clashes in the Syrian town of Ras al-Ain. And in a separate development on Saturday, rebel forces successfully seized control of an arms depot near Damascus, acquiring a cache of ammunition and weapons, including anti-tank missiles and rockets, from the regime.

The San Francisco 49ers made a bold move by drafting Will Redmond on a fateful Friday, a mere six months after his knee succumbed to the cruel grip of an ACL injury. In a poetic dance of hope and determination, Redmond has devoted himself to the arduous path of rehabilitation ever since that fateful practice drill. With a heart full of dreams and a spirit undaunted, he emerged from the shadows of doubt to shine at the Combine re-check, proving his resilience to the world. As Friday dawned, whispers of anticipation filled the air as Redmond declared his unwavering belief in his imminent return to the field, echoed by the hopeful words of Trent Baalke. Though skepticism lingers like a shadow, we hold our breath in silent prayer for his triumphant comeback. In the midst of uncertainty, a fleeting glimpse of Redmond's tenacity was captured in a video, a testament to his unwavering spirit as he raced on a treadmill with lightning speed. As the 49ers prepare for the trials of rookie minicamp, OTAs, and mandatory minicamp, the fate of Redmond hangs in the balance. Only on the first day of training camp will the decision be made, casting a light on the path ahead for the valiant warrior known as Will Redmond.

In the aftermath of Hurricane Maria, the dire situation in Puerto Rico has left much of the island in darkness, hindering communication between residents and their loved ones in the United States. However, a remarkable group of young radio enthusiasts from New York City's Garden School in Queens has stepped up to bridge this gap. The amateur radio club, with its 20 dedicated members, has taken on the task of transmitting 25-word messages from concerned individuals to Puerto Rico. This initiative, born out of a passion for radio contests, has now evolved into a vital lifeline for those in need. Through their station, K2GSG, the students meticulously craft and dispatch these messages, which are then prominently displayed in town centers for recipients to access. In a heartening display of solidarity, approximately 24 amateur radio operators in Puerto Rico are collaborating with local authorities to relay these radiograms, fostering a vital connection between the island and the outside world. This collaborative effort not only exemplifies the power of technology and human compassion but also serves as a poignant reminder of the resilience and spirit of community in times of crisis.

Hey there, racing game enthusiasts! So, we all know how Forza Motorsport has been dominating the Xbox scene, leaving PC gamers feeling a bit left out. But guess what? The good news is, Microsoft and Turn 10 have heard our cries and are finally bringing Forza Motorsport to Windows 10 PCs! Get ready for Forza Motorsport 6: Apex, a free version of the game that is sure to blow your mind. This game is packed with all the power and performance you could ever dream of, thanks to DirectX 12 technology. And get this - it even supports 4K resolution for those of you with top-of-the-line graphics cards. Trust me, you won't want to miss out on this thrilling experience!

In the ethereal realm of poetry and lore, the tale of Tristan and Iseult dances gracefully through the annals of time. A narrative woven with threads of Celtic myth, it found its voice in the 12th century through the pens of Thomas of Britain and Beroul, only to be reimagined by the likes of Gottfried of Strasbourg and Wagner. This timeless saga, born from the depths of ancient legend, captivated the hearts of medieval audiences across northern Europe with its poignant portrayal of love's forbidden embrace. The fateful meeting of the Cornish knight Tristan and the Irish queen Iseult, bound by a love potion on a treacherous voyage to Cornwall, resonates with a bittersweet harmony that defies societal norms and moral constraints. As they navigate the tumultuous waters of passion and duty, their love stands as a testament to the enduring power of the human heart, even in the face of moral ambiguity. Through the expert insights of scholars Laura Ashe, Juliette Wood, and Mark Chinca, we are invited to delve deeper into the complexities of this age-old tale, exploring the nuances of love, loyalty, and the eternal struggle between desire and righteousness. In the hands of these esteemed guests, the legend of Tristan and Iseult is brought to life once more, shimmering with new meaning and relevance for a modern audience eager to uncover the timeless truths nestled within its poetic embrace. As the echoes of their story linger in the air, we are reminded of the enduring legacy of love's eternal flame, flickering brightly against the backdrop of history's ever-shifting tapestry.

Pope Francis has recently sanctioned the establishment of a new Vatican department tasked with adjudicating cases involving bishops who have failed to safeguard children from predatory priests. This groundbreaking decision represents a significant stride towards holding bishops accountable for their complicity in concealing or neglecting to prevent instances of child sexual abuse within the Catholic church. The Vatican has disclosed that Pope Francis has endorsed the recommendations put forth by his advisory board on sexual abuse, which comprises a diverse group of individuals including clergy and laity - nine men and eight women. Their primary objective is to assist dioceses in implementing and enforcing "best practices" aimed at preventing abuse, as well as providing support to victims. Advocacy groups for victims have long advocated for the implementation of clear protocols by the Vatican to ensure bishops are held responsible for abuse within their jurisdictions, regardless of direct involvement. Although no bishop has faced forced removal for shielding guilty clergy thus far, in a notable instance, Pope Francis accepted the resignation of a US bishop who had been found guilty of failing to report a suspected child abuser in April.

Iranian reactions are expected in response to potential actions, ranging from support for Hezbollah in Lebanon to more limited measures. While it is hoped that Iran will exercise restraint, there is a possibility of a significant regional conflict involving the United States and countries in the Persian Gulf, leading to a surge in oil prices. The Obama administration has emphasized that all options are being considered regarding Iran's nuclear program, but strongly opposes any unilateral actions by Israel due to the potential risk it poses to American troops in Afghanistan and Iraq. Iran's support for militant groups in these countries could escalate in response to an attack, viewed by much of the Muslim world as endorsed by the US, complicating efforts to disengage from ongoing conflicts and damaging the US's reputation in the Muslim world. Furthermore, an attack could bolster the influence of hard-line Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad and his associates, consolidating support and weakening opposition both domestically and in the broader Muslim community.

A tragic incident unfolded in Ontario, Canada, as a passenger train derailed, resulting in the loss of three lives and injuring dozens more. The train, en route from Niagara Falls to Toronto, met a devastating end near Burlington, according to operator Via Rail. With approximately 75 passengers onboard, 45 were left wounded in the aftermath of the crash. The cause of the accident remains unknown at this time. Distressing images captured the aftermath, with a carriage overturned on its side. Via Rail confirmed that the deceased were employees, while a crew member sustained minor injuries. The harrowing scene was further compounded as emergency workers rushed to aid the injured, some requiring airlifts to hospitals. Burlington Mayor Rick Goldring described the impact of the crash on nearby structures. Passenger Deanna Villela shared her experience, recalling a sudden jolt before chaos ensued as the train veered off the tracks. The investigation into this tragic event has been initiated by Canada's Transportation Safety Board.

The similarities in design elements between the Adidas logo and a marijuana leaf were brought to attention by viewers during the airing of an Adidas commercial titled "Your Future Is Not Mine" on ABC Television during the first Presidential debate of 2016. In the commercial, a professional-scale marijuana grow facility is briefly shown at the 18-second mark, as part of the free form narrative directed by Terence Neale. The commercial, which has been online since January 2016 and garnered over 1 million views on YouTube, may be seen as reflecting millennial dissatisfaction with the political candidates. The inclusion of the marijuana industry in the commercial may have resonated with viewers, particularly in light of the political choices presented in the debate.

Hey everyone, I've got some news to share with you all. According to a recent report from the Globe and Mail, Dan Dodge, the co-founder and CEO of QNX Software Systems, has decided to retire at the end of the year. It's been confirmed by BlackBerry, so it's the real deal. We want to take a moment to thank Dan for all of his hard work and dedication to QNX and BlackBerry. He's been a huge part of building QNX into the leader in embedded software that it is today. With Dan's retirement, John Wall, who has been a key player in QNX's success as the Chief Operating Officer, will be stepping into the role of Senior Vice President and Head of QNX. We're grateful for all of Dan's 35 years of service and we wish him the best in his retirement. In a recent article, Dan mentioned that the decision to leave was entirely his own, and he even threw a big party to celebrate with everyone from QNX that he's known over the years. Dan Dodge and Gordon Bell actually started working on QNX as students at the University of Waterloo back in 1980, and by 1982, they released the first version of QNX. Pretty cool, right? QNX has come a long way since then, being used in everything from automotive systems to medical devices and network routers. It's even used in over 50 million vehicles in the automotive industry. So, Dan, we hope you enjoy your well-deserved retirement, and thanks for everything!

The paragraph effectively captures the author's admiration for rock 'n' roll instruments, specifically focusing on the historic significance of the late '40s Epiphone B-5 upright bass once owned by Marshall Lytle. The mention of Marshall's association with Bill Haley and His Comets and the iconic songs he recorded with this bass adds depth to the argument, highlighting its cultural impact. During a summer internship focused on astrophysics, Monash undergraduate Amelia Fraser-McKelvie made a significant contribution to the field by helping solve a longstanding mystery. Scientists have long theorized that the universe must contain more mass than is visible in the form of planets, dust, and stars. This missing mass, estimated to make up about half of the total mass needed to sustain the universe's current functions, had previously been unproven. Through her research, Ms. Fraser-McKelvie was able to identify some of this missing mass, a discovery that will have implications for the development of telescopes in Australia. Working alongside Monash astrophysicists Kevin Pimbblet and Jasmina Lazendic-Galloway, the 22-year-old aerospace engineering student was able to provide valuable insight into this complex scientific puzzle.

My local Food Basics grocery store has become my go-to spot for Spanish chorizo, and I must say, it has completely elevated my cooking game. The spicy, smoky flavor of this popular sausage has been a game-changer in my dishes, and I can't get enough of it. It's no wonder that chorizo is currently trending, with a plethora of mouth-watering recipes available online and on TV. But before you start experimenting with this flavorful ingredient, it's important to understand the differences between Spanish and Mexican chorizo. The Spanish and Portuguese varieties are typically made with chunks of pork and are cured, while Mexican chorizo is raw and uses ground or minced pork. This means that when cooking with Mexican chorizo, it's crucial to ensure it's fully cooked. Whether you're dicing and slicing Spanish chorizo to add to a dish or removing the raw meat from the casings to use in a recipe, the possibilities are endless. One of my favorite ways to enjoy chorizo is in a classic dish of scrambled eggs. The combination of the rich, savory sausage and fluffy eggs is a match made in culinary heaven, especially when tucked into a breakfast taco. Trust me, it's the perfect way to start your day on a delicious note.

A revered spiritual guru, his aura once bright, now tarnished by accusations of a dark and despicable act. Asaram Bapu, a beacon of wisdom and enlightenment, now shrouded in the shadow of alleged sexual assault on a young schoolgirl. The air thick with betrayal and disbelief as the news spreads through the devoted followers who once sought solace and guidance in his presence. The sacred retreat tainted by the ugly truth, the innocence of a child violated in the name of spirituality. The rhythmic chants and prayers now drowned out by the echoes of shame and disgust. The journey from revered guru to accused predator, a fall from grace that shakes the very foundation of faith and trust. Asaram Bapu, once hailed as a god among men, now stands accused, his halo shattered, his followers left to grapple with the bitter truth. The power of his influence waning as the weight of his alleged actions threatens to crush the devotion of those who once believed in his divine presence.

Mesut Ozil's impact on Arsenal goes beyond just his undeniable talent on the field. His ability to effortlessly dismantle opponents with his artistry and cool demeanor sets him apart as a game-changer. Unlike other attacking midfielders who may prioritize style over substance, Ozil's focus is always on creating opportunities and causing problems for the opposition. As a proven winner with an impressive list of achievements, including titles with Real Madrid and the German national team, Ozil brings a winning mentality to Arsenal. His expectation of success, combined with his selfless and purposeful style of play, make him a valuable asset to the team. In a sport where individual brilliance can sometimes overshadow team success, Ozil's commitment to the collective goal sets him apart as a truly exceptional player.

Sean Chen is a seasoned comic book artist with approximately 20 years of experience in the industry. He is best known for his extensive work on the Iron Man comic series, as well as various projects with Wolverine, X-Men, Spider-Man, and The Avengers, among others. Currently, he divides his time between creating comic book covers and special projects for different publishers, as well as producing storyboards for television commercials in the advertising industry. 

Gerardo Sandoval, on the other hand, has contributed to titles such as Age of Apocalypse, X-Men, Guardians 3000, New Avengers, Wolverine, and Venom. When asked about his favorite characters to draw from both the Marvel and Capcom universes, Sandoval expressed a preference for villains and anti-heroes, citing Venom, Wolverine, Sagat, and Zangief as his top choices. He finds these characters more compelling and enjoys portraying their darker, more complex personalities. Additionally, Sandoval mentioned that he often played as villains when gaming, further illustrating his affinity for these types of characters.

Encore Capital Group is a distinguished global specialty finance company with over six decades of operational expertise and a wealth of data accumulation. Tom Brady, a maestro on the field, feels the weight of lost companions in the Patriots' arsenal. The ghosts of Welker and Lloyd linger, haunting the once potent offense. Gronkowski, a titan of the gridiron, and Vereen, a swift shadow, are sidelined by cruel injuries. But it is the absence of Amendola that cuts deepest. Without his swift feet and sure hands, the Patriots' aerial dance stumbles and falters. Dobson and Thompkins, green apprentices, struggle to find harmony with their quarterback, leaving the air silent and still. Edelman, though valiant, cannot carry the burden alone. The return of the wounded warriors is uncertain, their past injuries casting a dark shadow of doubt. A veteran presence is needed, a sage to guide and steady the ship. Lloyd's departure leaves a void, his passion spent. So, who will answer the call to join the ranks of the Patriots and breathe life back into their faltering offense?

Law enforcement authorities are currently seeking the individual responsible for the theft of a vehicle from a paramedic affiliated with Burholme Emergency Medical Services, an organization that has been dedicated to providing emergency care to the Northeast Philadelphia community for nearly 85 years. According to EMS supervisor Blake Bradley, the incident occurred while the staff was responding to an emergency call on Friday night, during which an intruder unlawfully gained entry through a rear kitchen window at the non-profit EMS headquarters located on Bleigh Avenue. The perpetrator managed to locate and abscond with two sets of car keys, subsequently driving off in a white 2016 Jeep Compass belonging to an EMS worker. Bradley expressed dismay over the aggressive nature of the break-in, emphasizing the violation of security at a charitable medical institution. Authorities have identified at least one fingerprint left by the suspect on the window, and surveillance footage captured the individual entering and exiting the premises before fleeing in the stolen vehicle. Bradley urged anyone with pertinent information to come forward, underscoring the dedication of the affected dispatcher and the unprecedented nature of such criminal activity at the Burholme EMS establishment. In response to the incident, EMS personnel have implemented enhanced security measures to safeguard the premises, and are encouraging individuals to contact Northeast Detectives with any relevant details that may aid in the apprehension of the perpetrator.

The courtroom was tense as the 28-year-old man stood before the judge, his long hair pulled back in a bun and a short beard framing his face. The room was filled with the sound of whispered conversations and the scratching of pens on paper as the details of the case were discussed. The man's girlfriend, sitting in the gallery, described him as 'a boy with a big heart,' while the judge labeled him a 'pathological liar.' The man's eyes darted nervously around the room, his hands fidgeting with the hem of his shirt as he spoke.

As he recounted the events that led to his arrest, the room seemed to grow quieter, the tension palpable in the air. He described how he had purchased his first gun after being the victim of an act of aggression, his voice cracking with emotion. The memory seemed to hang heavy in the room, the weight of his fear and vulnerability almost tangible.

When he mentioned acquiring the second pistol after the devastating jihadist attacks in Paris, a collective gasp seemed to echo through the courtroom. The memory of that tragic day hung heavy in the air, a somber reminder of the dark times the city had faced. The man's reasons for carrying the guns seemed to blur the lines between fear and paranoia, his desperation for protection almost a living, breathing entity in the room.

Despite the gravity of the situation, there was a sense of relief that washed over the room as it was revealed that the man had no ties to terrorism. The tension seemed to dissipate, replaced by a sense of cautious curiosity as the details of the case were further explored. The man's fate now lay in the hands of the court, his future uncertain as he faced the consequences of his actions.

Approached by National Geographic Channel's 'Car SOS', we were tasked with restoring two cars for the third series of the television show. The second car we restored was a 1963 Alfa Romeo Giulia Spider. Despite its initial appearance, upon closer inspection, we found an excessive amount of underseal and filler under the car. As a precaution, we stripped the shell and sent it away for chemical dipping. Upon its return, it became evident that the car had undergone extensive repair work over the years, with numerous patches and poorly welded areas. Working with the bare metal, we completed the necessary fabrication work and replaced the front panel before applying Bianco Pininfarina paint. We rebuilt and painted the suspension, while the engine was serviced by an Alfa specialist. The trim work was completed by Aldridge in Walsall.

The documentary series, Human Planet, delves into the challenges faced by individuals living in extreme altitudes, where nature presents formidable obstacles for survival. In the Altai Mountains of western Mongolia, residents have developed a unique partnership with golden eagles for hunting in the vast open spaces. Meanwhile, in the Simien Mountains of Ethiopia, a young boy grapples with gelada monkeys threatening his family's grain harvest on steep cliffs. In Nepal, a sky burial ceremony is showcased as a cultural practice due to the scarcity of wood for cremation and the difficulty of traditional burial methods in the Himalayan region. Through these examples, Human Planet sheds light on the remarkable adaptability and resilience of people living in harsh mountain environments.

When Bandai Namco unveiled plans for a PC port of Dark Souls, the gaming community erupted with excitement. However, the subsequent announcement that the game would be released on the infamous Games For Windows Live platform sparked widespread frustration. Fortunately, a solution is on the horizon: starting in November, Dark Souls players currently on GFWL will have the opportunity to seamlessly transition to Steam. Beginning next month, users can exchange their GFWL tokens for access to Dark Souls on Steam. While this transfer option will remain open indefinitely, the transfer of save data and achievements will only be available for a limited period. Bandai Namco, in a recent update, assured players that more specific dates for this transition process will be released soon. Despite GFWL's impending demise, the publisher had previously affirmed its commitment to supporting Dark Souls players, distinguishing it as one of the few remaining games still linked to the service amidst a widespread migration to alternative platforms by other developers and publishers.

The allegation against Palin is that she violated state ethics regulations by conducting national television interviews regarding her vice presidential campaign from the governor's office. This complaint has emerged amidst ongoing scrutiny of Palin's personal life, potential future presidential aspirations, and public statements. Zane Henning, a North Slope resident from Wasilla, lodged the complaint with the attorney general, contending that Palin is using state facilities to advance her political ambitions, citing her interview with Greta Van Susteren on Fox News Channel on November 10 as a specific example. Henning asserts that Palin is leveraging her official position to rehabilitate her tarnished national reputation. In response, Palin's spokesperson, Bill McAllister, indicated that as the complaint falls under the executive branch ethics act, it is subject to confidentiality laws, and therefore declined further comment on the matter.

The glimmering symbol of success and controversy that is Donald Trump's Hollywood star has recently fallen victim to acts of defiance and disgust. It seems that not only humans, but even our furry friends are taking a stand against the Republican Party frontrunner, leaving their mark in the form of spray paint and animal waste. Despite the tarnishing of his star, Trump's presence on the Hollywood Walk of Fame remains steadfast, much to the dismay of those who oppose his divisive rhetoric and policies. The Hollywood Chamber of Commerce stands firm in their decision to keep the star, citing its historical significance and contribution to the iconic Walk of Fame.

Imagine trying to navigate a computer without being able to see the monitor. How would you know where to click, where to type, or what images should be displayed on the screen? These are the daily challenges faced by individuals who are blind or visually impaired. Many of us take for granted our ability to access and use the internet, but for those without sight, this seemingly simple task can be incredibly difficult. Despite these obstacles, individuals with visual impairments are finding innovative ways to utilize technology to access the online world. From smartphones to wearables, advancements in technology are making it easier for visually impaired individuals to navigate the digital landscape. However, without assistance from sighted individuals, many online functions remain out of reach for those with visual impairments. In order to bridge this gap, it is crucial to understand the unique challenges faced by individuals who are blind or visually impaired. By gaining insight from those who navigate the web without sight, we can begin to appreciate the internet in a whole new light.

The recent ruling stands out as a rare instance in which an individual owner or director of a company was successfully prosecuted for violating heritage laws. This landmark decision could potentially set a precedent for other Sydney councils in their efforts to protect and preserve heritage buildings. Leichhardt mayor Rochelle Porteous emphasized the significance of the case, stating, "Developers often hide behind their companies, but in this instance, the council directly pursued the owner of the company." The mayor believes that this ruling sends a powerful message to developers who try to circumvent heritage regulations, asserting, "We are adamant that heritage preservation is crucial. Any demolition or alteration of buildings must comply with council's planning guidelines." Porteous noted that several other Sydney councils have reached out to Leichhardt's legal team to applaud their victory and seek advice on replicating their success.

In the bustling streets of Paris, a dark cloud looms over the world of cycling as scientists debunk the myth of EPO as a performance enhancer. Despite the allure of gaining an edge in competition, riders who succumb to the temptation of doping with EPO may find themselves in a dangerous game of Russian roulette with their health. Lance Armstrong, once hailed as a cycling legend, faced a fall from grace when he was stripped of his Tour de France titles due to his involvement in systemic doping, including the use of EPO. The consequences of such illicit practices are dire, with the potential for life-threatening blood clots that can lead to strokes and heart attacks. "Athletes and their medical teams may be under the illusion that EPO boosts performance, but the truth remains that no substantial evidence exists to support this claim," remarked Adam Cohen, a distinguished professor at the Centre for Human Drug Research in the Netherlands. In the world of competitive cycling, the pursuit of victory at any cost may come at a steep price, both on and off the saddle.

One fatality and over 25 injuries were reported in the recent outbreak of violence in the Kandhamal region, with conflicting accounts from different religious groups regarding the trigger for the unrest. According to Christians, the violence erupted due to objections from Hindus over a Christmas celebration performance. Conversely, a Hindu group asserted that the conflict originated when Christians allegedly attempted to assault a local Hindu leader on Christmas Eve. The situation escalated further with an incident involving Swami Laxmananda Saraswati, who was reportedly surrounded while en route to the area but sustained minor injuries. Regardless of the initial catalyst, the culmination of the unrest was marked by the targeted attacks on churches on Christmas Day. Christians were forcibly expelled from multiple church structures, predominantly rudimentary mud huts with thatched roofs, before the structures were set ablaze. The casualty count remains ambiguous, with conflicting reports on the identity of the deceased individual. Subsequent to these events, a significant police presence was deployed to restore order, with the situation reportedly stabilizing by the following day. Orissa, a predominantly Hindu state with a minority Christian population, has a history of inter-religious tensions, exacerbated by legislation mandating police permission for religious conversions, ostensibly targeting Christian missionary activities. Allegations from Hindu groups of forced conversions by Christian organizations clash with the counterclaims of voluntary conversions by oppressed individuals seeking refuge from societal discrimination.

The clash erupted under the setting sun on a tranquil Sunday evening in the local park, as reported by Die Welt. A 32-year-old woman's canine companion left its mark on the grass, igniting a heated confrontation with a 33-year-old passer-by. Words turned to blows as the demand for cleanliness escalated into a violent exchange. Keys flew through the air, striking the dog owner's head before a gallant stranger intervened, momentarily restoring order. But peace was fleeting, as the dog owner returned with reinforcements, escalating the conflict into a chaotic melee involving five individuals. The sound of fists meeting flesh and the sight of a club in hand painted a grim picture of the escalating violence. The aftermath revealed torn hair, swollen arms, and serious wounds, prompting police to investigate charges of serious bodily harm. This incident adds to a growing trend of German outrage against negligent pet owners, as seen in a previous protest in Einbeck where locals adorned a statue with 250 kg of dog waste to send a message against laziness.

Hey there, folks! Let's talk about the latest hospital waiting list figures - they're a real eye-opener. Can you believe that over half a million patients were waiting for treatment at the end of September? That's a staggering number, but here's the good news: the waiting list for gastrointestinal checks is actually going down! According to the National Treatment Purchase Fund, nearly 80,000 people were waiting for inpatient or day case treatment last month. And hey, the number waiting for a gastrointestinal check has decreased too! But here's the kicker - over 430,000 people were waiting to be seen at an outpatient clinic, which is a bit of a bump from August. Minister for Health Simon Harris is on the case though, promising to cut those long wait times in half by the end of the year. Let's keep pushing for better healthcare for all!

The initial selection of games that will be compatible with Xbox Play Anywhere has been announced. These titles will be available for purchase on both Windows 10 and Xbox One platforms, with the added benefit of a cross-buy feature - purchasing one version grants access to the other at no additional cost. Furthermore, saved games and add-ons can seamlessly transition between both platforms. Microsoft unveiled the Xbox Play Anywhere initiative at its E3 2016 press conference, indicating that all future first-party games will adhere to this compatibility standard. While the list of supported games may not come as a surprise, it serves as a helpful reference for interested parties. The roster of Xbox Play Anywhere games includes Gears of War 4, Forza Horizon 3, ReCore, Sea of Thieves, Halo Wars 2, Scalebound, Killer Instinct Season 3, State of Decay 2, Ark: Survival Evolved, Cuphead, We Happy Few, and Crackdown 3. For further information, an Xbox Play Anywhere FAQ is available for additional clarification.

A worker at Montreal's La Ronde amusement park was fatally injured on Friday when he entered a restricted area while performing maintenance and was struck by a passing roller-coaster train. Ambulance workers provided treatment for shock to numerous ride patrons and employees following the incident. The 67-year-old employee was pronounced dead at the scene and no resuscitation efforts were made due to the severity of his injuries. La Ronde has announced that the ride will be closed indefinitely while an investigation is conducted. A park spokesperson stated that investigators are seeking to understand why the employee was in the restricted area and initial findings indicate that the ride was functioning properly, the restricted area was secure, and the employee did not inform the ride operator of his presence. The park expressed condolences to the family of the deceased employee in a statement.

According to Bob McKenzie of TSN, Joe Hicketts from Victoria is the lone defenseman at the camp who did not receive an invitation to the summer camp. Standing at 5-foot-8 and weighing 175 pounds, Hicketts does not possess exceptional size or speed, and he was not selected by an NHL team in the previous summer's draft. However, following his participation in Detroit's summer prospect camp and subsequent invitation to the Wings' rookie tournament in Traverse City, the undrafted free agent left a strong impression on the Wings' management, earning himself an NHL contract. Hicketts has been a standout offensive player in the WHL this season, leading all defensemen in scoring with seven goals and 36 points in 28 games, ranking fifth overall in the league. Additionally, Hicketts' former coach in Victoria, Lowry, will be overseeing the defensemen for Groulx at the camp. While Hicketts may not possess the same flashy skills as players like Ryan Ellis from 2009 and 2010, he compensates with a determined and effective playing style that contributes to his scoring success.

Fixed pricing for consumer goods and services is predicted to become a relic of the past within the next five years, as a wave of Uber-style pricing innovation sweeps through the United Kingdom. The era of "peak time" pricing, where the cost of goods fluctuates in accordance with demand, is poised to become the new norm in supermarkets, petrol stations, and utility bills. Unlike traditional paper price tags, the emergence of "e-prices" tethered to the intricate algorithms of retailers' computer systems allows for swift adjustments of up to 90% within a single day. This cutting-edge technology empowers stores to dynamically respond to market shifts, enabling them to swiftly withdraw discounts on coveted items, such as ice creams and chilled beverages during scorching heatwaves, or premium sandwiches during the bustling lunch hour. While this pricing model is already prevalent in Europe and the United States, its potential introduction in the UK is certain to stir up a fervor among consumers who are increasingly attuned to the nuances of cost-conscious shopping.

A recent revelation in Andhra Pradesh has shed light on the state's dire financial situation, with a staggering debt of 17,500 crores. Despite this alarming figure, the government has somehow found the funds to lavish 175 members of the legislative assembly with iPhone6s, at a cost exceeding Rs 1 crore to taxpayers. This extravagant gesture, a continuation of a tradition of expensive electronic gifts to lawmakers, highlights the misplaced priorities of Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu and his administration. While farmers struggle with loan burdens and cities suffer from inadequate infrastructure, the state's leaders are indulging in unnecessary luxuries at the expense of the public purse. Such wasteful spending not only demonstrates a lack of fiscal responsibility but also a disconnect from the pressing needs of the people they are meant to serve.

Numerous studies have delved into the intricate connection between a specific genetic variant in the promoter region of the MAOA gene and the manifestation of antisocial tendencies. The findings consistently point to a correlation between low-activity MAOA alleles and antisocial behaviors in males who have experienced childhood maltreatment. However, recent findings have introduced a new dimension to this complex puzzle, suggesting that a rare allele of the MAOA gene - specifically, the 2-repeat allele - may exert its influence on violent behaviors independently of environmental factors. This groundbreaking study seeks to expand upon existing research by exploring the link between the 2-repeat allele and acts of shooting and stabbing in a cohort of males from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health. The results of the analysis paint a stark picture: African-American males carrying the 2-repeat allele exhibit a significantly heightened propensity for engaging in shooting and stabbing incidents, as well as reporting multiple victims. Despite the valuable insights gained from this study, its limitations are acknowledged, and recommendations for future investigations are put forth.

In this paper, we delve into the depths of history to uncover the institutional factors that fueled persecution during the Black Death pogroms in the Holy Roman Empire. The political fragmentation that plagued the empire only served to heighten the greed and power struggles within its borders. As a result, Jewish communities found themselves at the mercy of intense persecutions during this dark period. Through meticulous analysis of data on pogrom intensity, trade routes, and political and ecclesiastical boundaries, we unveil a troubling pattern. Communities located near Archbishoprics, Bishoprics, and Imperial Free cities bore the brunt of violent attacks, while those under imperial rule faced a lesser degree of brutality. This revelation forces us to confront the harsh reality of weak states and their struggle to uphold the rule of law.

The start to her day could have been catastrophic. As Inocenta Hernandez in Guatemala City took her first step out of bed, she was met with a 40-foot deep and nearly 3-foot wide sinkhole directly under her bed. The unexpected event left her and her family in shock, initially mistaking the loud boom for a gas explosion or a street crash. After a frantic search, they discovered the source of the noise right under her bed. This incident is not uncommon in the area, as Guatemala City is known for its susceptibility to sinkholes. In 2010, a massive sinkhole swallowed buildings and an intersection, while in 2007, another sinkhole tragically claimed three lives. Despite the material damages to her home, Hernandez remains grateful that her grandchildren, who were running around the house at the time, were unharmed. "Thank God there are only material damages," she said. This harrowing experience serves as a reminder of the unpredictable nature of the environment in which she lives.

This concept was inspired by a suggestion on Reddit. The design features a greatsword with a unique functionality of launching a shuriken by swinging the blade. The sword has two forms: the primary form is a standard greatsword-type weapon, while the secondary form allows the blades to separate, enabling a shuriken stored at the base of the blade to be propelled out using the momentum of the swing. The shuriken is the most intriguing aspect of the weapon, as it is connected to the sword via a cable that can extend up to 20 meters when launched. The shuriken starts in a collapsed form and transforms into a weaponized form once it leaves the blade. The cable allows for the retraction of the shuriken back into the sword after it is thrown, with the option to stop the retraction to extend the reach of sword swings. The retracted shuriken can also be used for grappling purposes, with the ability to adjust the blade angles for optimal ledge-catching. The sword includes two spare shurikens and the option to detach the cable from the loaded shuriken in emergency situations. These spare shurikens serve as backups in case the main shuriken is damaged or inaccessible.

A San Francisco-based start-up named Good2Go has developed an innovative solution to address the challenge of locating clean and well-maintained public restrooms in major urban areas. The company's newly launched iOS app, which will be accessible to users beginning this Thursday, provides a comprehensive map of nearby private establishments offering restroom facilities, coupled with estimated wait times. Upon arrival at the chosen location, users can seamlessly unlock the restroom door by utilizing an app-generated code, eliminating the need for physical keys or permission from establishment staff. Good2Go has also established partnerships with various businesses, including restaurants and grocery stores, to expand its network of accessible restroom facilities. Furthermore, the start-up has taken measures to modernize these facilities by implementing touchless technology, encompassing lights, sinks, hand dryers, and toilets, all of which are activated through sensor-based interaction. Additionally, the doors to Good2Go restrooms open automatically, further enhancing the touchless experience for users.

His ruse was quickly discovered, causing a delay in the trial as other jurors were dismissed. Judge Martin Rudland did not take kindly to Banks' deception, calling him "frivolous" and sentencing him to two weeks in a Young Offenders' Institution. Despite the judge's reluctance to hand down such a harsh punishment, he emphasized the gravity of lying to court officials for personal gain. While Banks may miss spending Christmas with his loved ones, the trial carried on without him, with the remaining jurors reaching a verdict. The tale of the juror who traded justice for a night of showbiz will surely be remembered as a cautionary example of the consequences of deceit in the halls of justice.

Britain's Home Secretary, Amber Rudd, has expressed her dismay to her American counterpart over the premature disclosure of the Manchester suicide bomber's identity to the US media. Mrs. Rudd made the bold move of publicly voicing the UK government's frustration with the Americans on Wednesday, while investigators continued their efforts to uncover potential accomplices of 22-year-old Salman Abedi. In the early hours of Wednesday morning, local time, authorities in Manchester apprehended three individuals in the city's southern region, adding to the arrest of a 23-year-old man connected to the attack. US media outlets identified this man as Abedi's brother, citing "US officials". Similar to the response to the Westminster attack in April, British media refrained from releasing the attacker's name, despite being aware of it, in order to safeguard the ongoing investigation and prevent alerting any additional suspects. However, on Tuesday, US networks CBS and NBC disclosed the perpetrator's identity hours before Greater Manchester police confirmed it.

New Hope Academy, a private therapeutic day school for students in grades 6-12, is in the process of relocating from Niles to Arlington Heights. The school's executive director, Brandy Larrance, has announced that the new location at 3250 N. Arlington Heights Road, just south of Dundee Road, will be operational before the start of the 2017-18 school year in August. Founded in 2000, the school serves students with special needs from 35 suburban school districts, including Northwest Suburban High School District 214, Palatine-Schaumburg High School District 211, and school districts as far as Gurnee, Naperville, and Yorkville. With an enrollment of 65 students at its current location in Niles, the school plans to increase enrollment to 80 with the move to Arlington Heights. New Hope Academy will occupy 18,000 square feet of a 73,000-square-foot, multi-tenant office building, which is currently about two-thirds vacant. The new facility will include 12 classrooms, an art studio, gym, cafeteria, staff lounge, and offices. The village board has approved a land use variation to accommodate the school's move, and New Hope Academy plans to install new landscaping before occupying the new space.

Visa Europe has initiated the suspension of payments to the whistle-blowing website Wikileaks as part of an ongoing investigation into the organization. This decision mirrors a similar action taken by rival payments processor Mastercard earlier this week. The announcement from Visa follows the arrest of Wikileaks' founder, Julian Assange, by authorities in London. Mr. Assange, whose website has been responsible for the publication of confidential documents, is currently facing allegations of sexual assault in Sweden. Wikileaks relies on donations made through online platforms to sustain its operations, a method that has now been hindered with the discontinuation of Visa and Mastercard debit and credit card transactions. A spokesperson for Visa Europe has stated that the investigation will delve into the nature of Wikileaks' business practices and assess whether they are in compliance with Visa's operational guidelines. The suspension of payments to Wikileaks is not immediate, as the process requires a certain amount of time to be completed. Mastercard has also released a statement indicating their efforts to cease the acceptance of Mastercard cards on Wikileaks until the situation is resolved. In a similar fashion, online payment company PayPal and tech giant Amazon have severed ties with Wikileaks in recent days.

President Obama's political momentum has surged through the battleground states, as revealed by the latest Marist College, NBC News, and Wall Street Journal polling. The data paints a vivid picture of Obama's lead in key swing states, with Florida and Virginia showing him ahead by five points and Ohio by seven. This surge in Obama's popularity following the Democratic National Convention suggests that his impassioned speeches and stirring rhetoric have resonated deeply in the hearts of voters. The impact of this bump is significant, as it not only boosts Obama's national polling but also strengthens his position in the crucial swing states. The numbers tell a compelling story, with Obama currently holding a solid 50 percent to 43 percent lead in Ohio and a 49 percent to 44 percent advantage in both Florida and Virginia. These states are pivotal, providing a combined total of 60 electoral votes, making them a crucial battleground in the race for the White House. Should Obama secure victory in at least two of these states, it would create a formidable obstacle for Romney, narrowing his path to the presidency. As the dust settles from the convention, the stakes are high, and every percentage point in these swing states becomes a critical factor in the unfolding drama of the election.

In the wake of a week filled with nonsensical chaos revolving around a deceitful racial imposter, and the heart-wrenching tragedy of a merciless massacre in a sacred black church, we find ourselves here, on the momentous 150th anniversary of Juneteenth. This day serves as a solemn reminder that it was only on this day, a century and a half ago, that the last remnants of American slavery were finally informed of their long-denied freedom. And yet, as we stand here today, it seems that the dream of a post-racial society remains frustratingly elusive, slipping through our fingers like sand. 

For the first time in history, a black man resides within the hallowed walls of the White House. And yet, despite his historic presence, he has been reluctant to make bold strides towards bridging the ever-widening chasm of racial division. However, today, on this momentous occasion, he has the opportunity to rectify this hesitation, to seize the power of simplicity and drama, and to etch his name into the annals of presidential legacy. Today, he could issue an apology on behalf of a nation that was once the largest purveyor of human bondage, the land of the free tarnished by its dark and horrifying past. 

The flag of the Confederacy, defiantly waving in the South Carolina Statehouse grounds, serves as a stark and painful reminder of the venomous animosity that fueled the audacious claim that one human being could own another. It is a reminder that this insidious hatred, born from the depths of a nation's soul, has stubbornly clung to our shores, refusing to be banished, even as time marches forward. And yet, an apology, however seemingly insignificant, possesses the potential to unleash a ripple of positivity, reverberating through the ages. It may not eradicate the roots of this hatred, but it has the power to plant the seeds of change, to sow a collective consciousness that yearns for unity, justice, and understanding. 

In this act of contrition, the weight of history could be lifted, if only for a moment, as the country collectively exhales a breath held captive by the ghosts of its past. It would be a balm for the wounded hearts of those who have carried the invisible scars of their ancestors, a testament to the resilience of the human spirit. And as this apology echoes through the corridors of time, it will serve as a poignant reminder that even amidst the darkest chapters of our shared history, a flicker of hope remains, burning brightly, guiding us towards a future where the chains of prejudice and bigotry are forever shattered.

McGinn, at the young age of 27, showcased his resilience and determination as he skated in 21 games with the Syracuse Crunch of the American Hockey League last season. Despite missing most of the regular season due to injury, he managed to make a significant impact with 10 goals and 19 points, including four goals on the power play. His presence was felt even more during the intense Calder Cup playoff games, where he recorded five goals and 16 points in 22 games.

Standing tall at 6-foot-3 and weighing 218 pounds, McGinn has proven himself over the course of his five-season career in the AHL, accumulating an impressive 76 goals and 142 points in 256 games. Hailing from Fergus, Ontario, he has also had a taste of the NHL, skating in 89 games and notching nine goals and 17 points, along with 44 penalty minutes. His Lightning debut on November 1, 2015, against the Carolina Hurricanes marked a significant milestone in his journey.

Originally drafted by the Philadelphia Flyers in the fourth round of the 2010 NHL Draft, McGinn's story is one of perseverance and passion for the sport he loves. Anusha Samaranayake, the renowned Sri Lanka Cricket fast-bowling coach, has emerged from the shadows of suspicion, his name cleared of the dark cloud of fixing allegations that had cast a shadow over his reputation since February. The Sri Lanka Cricket board had launched a thorough inquiry into Samaranayake's alleged involvement in the nefarious world of fixing, following reports of a sinister approach made to multiple Sri Lanka cricketers. However, in a twist of fate, the International Cricket Council (ICC) has swooped in to exonerate Samaranayake, stating unequivocally that there is no tangible evidence linking him to any breaches of their stringent Anti-Corruption Code.

Yet, despite this vindication, Samaranayake finds himself in a state of professional limbo, his once illustrious role with SLC suspended indefinitely due to a separate disciplinary infraction that has come to light. SLC Secretary, Mohan de Silva, has shed light on this new transgression, revealing that it pertains to Samaranayake's alleged indiscretions in entertaining guests at SLC's prestigious academy in Khettarama. While Samaranayake's contractual ties with SLC are set to extend until the waning days of December, the organization appears reticent to reinstate him to his former position, casting a pall of uncertainty over his future within the cricketing realm.

Despite the tumultuous turn of events, one cannot deny the indelible mark that Samaranayake has left on the landscape of Sri Lankan fast bowling. The likes of Lasith Malinga and Nuwan Kulasekara, among others, have credited him with shaping their careers and honing their craft to perfection. As the fate of this enigmatic coach hangs in the balance, SLC has promised a definitive resolution on his future in the imminent weeks, leaving the cricketing fraternity on tenterhooks as they await the final verdict on the destiny of a man whose legacy is intertwined with the very fabric of Sri Lankan cricket.

Apple's Mac sales have defied the odds by continuing to soar, even as the overall PC market shrinks. However, Apple isn't the only player winning the desktop and laptop game. Lenovo has recently announced significant increases in both revenue and profits, proudly declaring that its PC shipments in the US have surpassed Apple's for the first time. This achievement has secured Lenovo the coveted third spot in the market, trailing behind the stalwart giants, HP and Dell. This claim is supported by recent data, likely curated with the help of industry analysts at IDC. It's worth noting that just a few months ago, Gartner still had Lenovo in fourth place in the US. Regardless of differing opinions, Lenovo has undeniably dominated the global PC market for about a year now, largely due to the success of its expanding ThinkPad line. Furthermore, the company has seen growth in its non-Windows tablet and smartphone sales, with the latter poised to make a significant impact in the US following Lenovo's acquisition of Motorola.

The enigmatic Friedrich Nietzsche, a figure both revered and reviled in equal measure, stands as a towering intellectual force of the 19th century. His radical ideas, which cut through the fabric of traditional beliefs with surgical precision, shook the foundations of religion, morality, and science. In a world stripped bare of divine guidance, Nietzsche's philosophy emerged as a beacon of stark originality, challenging the very essence of human existence. As historian Bettany Hughes delves into the complex web of Nietzsche's beliefs, she uncovers a man whose disdain for conventional truths left his ideas shrouded in ambiguity and open to misinterpretation. Despite his vocal opposition to oppressive ideologies such as anti-Semitism and nationalism, Nietzsche's own sister twisted his legacy to align with Hitler's Aryan agenda. Tragically, the philosopher's descent into madness and isolation only served to further distort his profound insights, which continue to shape the intellectual landscape of the modern world. Nietzsche's tumultuous journey serves as a cautionary tale of the dangers of misrepresentation and manipulation in the realm of ideas.

In the first step, the onions are chopped in a food processor, followed by the addition of garlic and ginger which are then finely processed. This mixture is then cooked over low heat until it becomes fragrant, typically taking about one minute. The previously prepared onion mixture is then added and cooked over high heat, with occasional stirring, until it turns golden brown, usually taking about six minutes. Subsequently, turmeric and tomato sauce are added to the casserole and simmered over moderately high heat, with occasional stirring, until the mixture slightly thickens, typically taking about three minutes. Finally, in step three, the chicken breasts are seasoned with salt and added to the casserole, where they are coated with the sauce. Water is then added, and the casserole is covered and brought to a boil. The mixture is then simmered over low heat, with the chicken being turned a few times, until it becomes white throughout, typically taking about 10 minutes. The chicken curry is then seasoned with salt to taste.

One of the most widely accepted beliefs regarding the evolution of the human brain is the idea that the frontal lobes underwent significant enlargement. However, our research challenges this notion, revealing that this assumption lacks a solid foundation. Through a meticulous analysis of five distinct data sets using properly scaled measures and phylogenetic methods, we have discovered that the size of the human frontal lobes and specific regions within them align as expected in relation to other brain structures. Claims suggesting a relative enlargement of human frontal white matter volume, as well as a shared enlargement among all great apes, have been found to be inaccurate. Additionally, our innovative approach for detecting shifts in evolutionary rates has demonstrated that the rate of change in relative frontal cortex volume leading to humans was not extraordinary, with other branches showing significantly faster rates of change. While the absolute and proportional size of frontal regions did indeed increase rapidly in humans, this growth was closely correlated with similar increases in other brain areas and overall brain size, alongside decreases in frontal neuron densities. As we delve into the search for the neural underpinnings of human cognitive distinctiveness, it is imperative to shift our focus away from the frontal lobes in isolation and towards the intricate web of distributed neural networks. By embracing this holistic perspective, we can gain a deeper understanding of what truly sets the human mind apart.

Rita's Italian Ice is currently in the process of temporarily discontinuing the availability of frozen custard, as a result of the nationwide egg shortage caused by the country's most severe avian flu outbreak. Customers visiting over 600 of the chain's locations, including those in central Pennsylvania, will now be offered soft-serve ice cream in place of custard. The shortage of eggs stems from the avian flu epidemic, which has greatly impacted flocks of egg-laying chickens predominantly in the Midwest, consequently leading to a surge in egg prices. Since December 2014, more than 48 million birds, primarily chickens and turkeys, have been affected. The shortage of eggs and the subsequent increase in prices have affected restaurants nationwide, with some establishments raising the prices of their breakfast items. Texas-based Whataburger has adjusted their breakfast hours in response to the shortage. Rita's spokesperson, Ariel Vegotsky, stated that Rita's has never before experienced such a significant impact from a national food shortage. She explained that the chain is currently unable to obtain the necessary egg supplies for their 600 stores, leading to the transition to serving soft-serve at some locations, with others in the process of depleting their remaining custard supplies. Vegotsky mentioned that eventually, all Rita's locations will be serving soft-serve, though the timeline for this switch remains uncertain. However, Rita's plans to reintroduce custard once the supply chain stabilizes. Despite the change, customers have been understanding and pleased with the soft-serve offering, which Vegotsky noted tastes similar to custard. She reported that the response from guests has been positive thus far. This updated version of the story provides additional details regarding the avian flu outbreak.
